# Panel 256's blind seat: the blinding key, published after the scoring

Published 2026-11-23 by the session that scored the blind seat, after every graded session had been written
down by its folder's letter (`llm-ergonomist-blind.md` § How it was run). The key below is the `key.txt` the
run's `make_sessions.py` wrote beside `s/`, never inside a session's folder, reproduced byte for byte: its
first line names the label each arm was drawn, and each row a folder, its arm and the sha256 of each file the
session was handed. The draw was made between the registration's two writings (`256-briefs/blind/RUN.md`
§ One correction before any paid session) and before any session ran; the same bytes stand in
`llm-ergonomist-blind-answers.tar.xz` (`256-llm-ergonomist/key.txt`), and the order the sessions ran in is
`order.txt`, reproduced after the key.

Every `heroes-spec.md` hash below is one of the four the registration names (`arms/spec-now.md`
`15804f3fb52a62c2...`, `arm-gc.md` `99e080b00a996ad9...`, `arm-gi.md` `2d14c084ed997ad3...`, `arm-gr.md`
`32b0504b44f98852...`), the `gi` arm being the frozen spec with R1's sentence and **not** `spec-r.md` (sha256
`6c905ad57c68d63c...`), which adds R6's `m.number()` sentence.
